line_verbatim: Solenodon paradoxus i yg; nl It 1285

The 1 kg, nocturnal solenodonts ( Solenodon cubanus, S. paradoxus) from Cuba, Santa Domingo and Haiti are insectivores with antimesometrial implantation of a hemochorial, discoidal, labyrinthine placenta into a uterus with a large body and two blunt horns (176, 11853)
